sources.title: QCNet Trajectory Prediction Model Training - Horizon OpenExplorer ...
sources.snippet: This tutorial primarily guides you on training a QCNet model from scratch on the Argoverse 2 dataset, including floating-point, quantized, and fixed-point models. QCNet is a trajectory prediction model, which can be referenced in the paperQuery-Centric Trajectory Prediction.
